messages:
eval-bot: nightly-eval alert: ptq-variant 'ptq-2a' on model-repo/finbert v2 -> promptset 'finance-short' fail rate +18% vs baseline (p<0.01). Affected metrics: factuality_score down 0.12, hallucination_count up 2.
sara: saw this in the dashboard, looks like failures are concentrated on Q/A prompts with numeric citations.
matt: any change in quant kernels or packing last deploy?
eval-bot: deploy-log: build 2026-03-19T02:14Z -> ptq-2a introduced packed-kv-v2 and int8-fast-gemm kernels. Canary rollout 5% started 2026-03-19T03:00Z.
cheng: repro attempt: running the failing prompt locally against ptq-2a (cpu sim) shows answer swapping numbers in 3/5 seeds. attaching snippet.
cheng: ```
# repro sketch
python -m rl_eval.run --model finbert:ptq-2a --prompt "What was revenue in Q3?"
# observed: "$1.2B" -> expected "$120M" (scale mismatch)
```
sara: that smells like a scale/quant casting issue (packed-kv interaction with scale factors). Could be layernorm or matmul scaling.
matt: quick triage: compare weight range stats between fp16 and ptq-2a for the top 3 attention proj layers. I bet we clipped a range during per-channel-scale step.
nana: (typo) -> ana: I'm on it, pulling weight histograms now. If confirmed, we should kill the canary and pin hosted->fp16 fallback.
oncall-ml: suggested mitigation sequence: 1) pause ptq-2a canary (set rollout=0%); 2) pin production routing to finbert:fp16-verified for the affected routes (promptset tag: finance-short); 3) open rollback PR for ptq-2a and mark as gated in model-catalog; 4) add targeted eval checks for numeric scale and citation tokens.
sara: agree. add an immediate eval gating rule: if factuality_score delta < -0.08 and hallucination_count +>1 on critical promptsets -> block rollout.
matt: who wants to own the rollback? I can cut the rollback PR and smoke test.
cheng: I'll correlate kernel versions with the specific failures and produce a short root-cause note by EOD. Hypothesis: packed-kv-v2 introduces a rescaling pass that interacts poorly with int8-fast-gemm quant params.
nana: (again) -> ana: added ticket ML-1234, assigned to cheng and matt. I'll schedule a quick canary rollback now.
oncall-ml: rollback initiated: canary set to 0% at 2026-03-19T03:18Z. Routing pinned. Please monitor nightly eval delta and production error logs.
sara: thanks. follow-up: add a unit test for numeric-citation prompts in the eval harness so this triggers earlier.
matt: PR raised for rollback: github.com/redwood-inference/finbert/rollbacks#42. smoke passed on staging.
cheng: root-cause note (draft): probable quant scale mismatch between packed-kv-v2 adjacency pass and per-channel quantization table leading to order-of-ops numeric scaling errors. Next steps: reproduce minimal repro, revert packed-kv-v2 in ptq-2a, add gating test, run kernel-level compare tools.
sara: good. leave this thread for updates; if anything spikes in prod alert me @sara. :thumbsup:
